+"""RoboWits limited-mode scoop routine used in this episode.

+The script never resets the service.  It uses the overhead and wrist RGB

+
+import numpy as np

+

+

+    right = now[16:23]
+    x, y = xy

+        dtype=np.float32,

+        actions,

+        cameras=("ego", "wrist_left"),

+    )
